## Download

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **`KeepFrame-Setup-*.exe`** | Windows installer: recommended. Start-menu + optional desktop shortcut. |
| **`KeepFrame-portable.zip`** | No install: unzip anywhere and run `KeepFrame.exe`. |

No Python needed. The AI model (DINOv2-small, Apache-2.0) is included and runs on your GPU
(DirectML: NVIDIA / AMD / Intel) or on the CPU. Everything runs 100% offline.

> **Windows SmartScreen**: the app is not code-signed yet, so Windows may show
> *"Windows protected your PC"*. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

### Türkçe
**`KeepFrame-Setup-*.exe`** dosyasını indirip kurun; Python gerekmez, yapay zekâ modeli içinde gelir.
SmartScreen uyarısı çıkarsa **Ek bilgi → Yine de çalıştır** deyin.
